gradient_interpretation.gradient_norm_mean_preclip: mean total norm reported by the frozen trainer before global clip_grad_norm_
gradient_interpretation.ppo_ratio_clip_fraction: PPO ratio clipping fraction; not the global gradient clipping incidence
